rv.q: This is theater as comfort food, and it satisfies a genuine craving.

Sure enough, the play features a cast of endearingly quirky characters engaged in a romantic duel with sprinklings of humor amid the pathos of love lost and found. And I must say, Lyons and his terrific company did one better than the old romcoms. Table 17 is a deliciously heartfelt study of an ex-couple that’s as funny as it is profound.

vr.q: Table 17 is such a unique in on a romcom and I just love everything about it
It was just a really enjoyable piece and a refreshingly simple but well done concept.
If you saw chicken and biscuits and really loved it, you have to go see table 17.
